DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT) with secondary peripheral neuropathy.

I have noted your denial of fever or respiratory symptoms, which rules out pneumonia; however, the combination of a pruritic rash on sun-exposed areas (face/upper body), sensory neuropathy in the palms, and exposure to livestock and rice farming strongly suggests a metabolic disorder like PCT or potentially heavy metal poisoning.
